source: Hyperliquid public API (leaderboard + vaults + userRole + clearinghouseState + metaAndAssetCtxs)

universe.rule: account value >= $100,000; PnL > 0 in the week, month and allTime leaderboard windows; 30-day volume / account value <= 100; not a vault (Hyperliquid vault list) or a sub-account / agent (Info API userRole); ranked by 30-day ROI capped at its 99th percentile (ties: 30-day PnL); top 300. Frozen until the next Monday 00:00 UTC.

flows.note: Panel only. Size changes in coins valued at the current mark (a price move alone is never a flow). Wallets that did not answer in both runs are left out. No flow is written for an interval without a cached previous snapshot.
